{
  "correction_rules": [
    "Adjust forecasts downward when sentiment history includes positive sentiment (e.g., >0.00) and model overestimates prices, especially after recent spikes.",
    "Reduce forecast magnitude when true outcomes show mean reversion toward lower levels after sustained high prices.",
    "Apply a lag correction: if true outcome is significantly lower than forecast, reduce forecast by 5-10% for the next period to account for delayed market reaction.",
    "Increase forecast sensitivity to sentiment history: if sentiment is negative (e.g., <0.00), apply a downward bias of 3-5% to prevent over-optimism.",
    "Cap forecast growth after a spike: if model forecasts a sharp upward move following a peak, reduce the slope of the forecast curve to avoid overshoot.",
    "Use historical mean as baseline: if true outcome deviates >10% from 10-day moving average, adjust forecast toward the mean to reduce systematic bias.",
    "Apply downward correction for consecutive low true outcomes: if 3+ consecutive days show low prices, reduce forecast by 5-8% to reflect weakening momentum."
  ]
}
